note: Micon submodule: adds an Icon (#type micon) picker to the taxonomy vocabulary form and stores the chosen icon selector as a third-party setting on the taxonomy_vocabulary config entity: third_party_settings.micon_vocabulary.icon (e.g. fa-tags). No settings form/route, no list builder. Read via micon_vocabulary_icon($vocabulary) or getThirdPartySetting('micon_vocabulary','icon'). Registers vocabulary.<lowercased label> micon_icons via hook_micon_icons_alter(). Medium/hard grounded in that third-party setting on a vocabulary.

evals.prompt: With the micon_vocabulary module, where is a taxonomy vocabulary's chosen Micon icon stored, and under which key?
evals.expected_output: On the taxonomy_vocabulary config entity as a third-party setting: third_party_settings.micon_vocabulary.icon = the icon selector (e.g. fa-tags). Read with micon_vocabulary_icon($vocabulary).

evals.prompt: How do I set the Micon icon fa-tags on the Tags vocabulary in PHP using micon_vocabulary?
How can I reference a vocabulary's Micon icon by a string through Micon's icon matcher when using micon_vocabulary?
evals.expected_output: Via hook_micon_icons_alter() it registers vocabulary.<lowercased label>, so micon('vocabulary.tags') resolves to that vocabulary's icon.

evals.prompt: This site has a taxonomy vocabulary with machine name (vid) micon_vocab_med given a Micon icon via micon_vocabulary. Inspect the live site and report the icon selector stored for it.
evals.expected_output: The stored icon is fa-tags: taxonomy.vocabulary.micon_vocab_med has third_party_settings.micon_vocabulary.icon = fa-tags.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a taxonomy vocabulary with vid micon_vocab_task that has no Micon icon. Using micon_vocabulary, set its icon to fa-star and apply the change to the live site.
